contents.locator: §10.1, p.89, with the invariant sigma algebra defined in §9.4, p.84
contents.support: Walkden states the probability-space result directly. Normalize any finite positive measure to probability without changing null sets or conditional-average identities; the zero-mass case is vacuous. The page expresses the same identification by invariant-set integrals and Radon–Nikodym, without importing conditional-expectation terminology.
